description:
🚀 Andalusian ingenuity

Colonizing the Moon? No ni ná, hold my beer, mate! 🍻🌕

An Andalusian team, passionate about technology and eager to prove that ingenuity knows no borders… or gravity. A proposal combining science, sustainability, engineering, and a whole lot of creativity.

Because if there's one thing we're sure of, it's that when Andalusia sets its sights on the Moon, it doesn't ask if it's possible… It asks where to park the rocket! 🚀
summary:
Wonder Space is a browser-based educational adventure for children aged 7–12, developed for the Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. Ten playable missions combine 3D exploration with interactive puzzles, helping young learners understand how decisions affect a space outpost.

Players recover resources, choose between energy savings and stronger radiation protection, and allocate water and lighting to grow food. Other challenges explore planetary order, circuit repair, orbital control, rocket assembly, landing and navigation. 

Two selectable astronauts, unlockable accessories and short mission-completion films support engagement.

Nova, a friendly robot companion, provides progressive contextual hints, with optional local AI integration for conversational assistance. Published science resources inform lunar gravity, planetary order and solar-storm scenarios, complex processes are simplified for educational gameplay.

With Spanish and English interfaces, keyboard and touch controls, reduced-motion options and local progress saving, Wonder Space aims to make space learning approachable. Its intended impact is to build scientific curiosity, problem-solving and confidence through experimentation and visible consequences.
details:
🚀 Wonder Space is an educational browser game that introduces children aged 7–12 to the decisions involved in space exploration. Its central idea is learning through action: explore, make a choice, observe its consequences and try again.

🎮 The prototype contains ten playable missions. Three use a 3D lunar environment where players walk, jump, collect resources and reach mission objectives. Seven additional challenges involve arranging the planets, cultivating food, repairing a satellite circuit, controlling an orbit, assembling a rocket, landing on Mars and navigating an asteroid field.

⚡ Resource decisions connect the experience to the challenge. During the shelter mission, players choose between conserving energy and installing stronger protection. In the space garden, they allocate limited water and energy for lighting across successive growing turns. These activities make competing needs tangible without requiring advanced scientific knowledge.

👩‍🚀 Players can choose a boy or girl astronaut and unlock accessories through completed missions. Animated characters, a moving robot companion and short completion films create continuity between exploration and puzzles.

🤖 Nova supports learners with progressive, context-aware hints. The default guide uses predefined rules and works without an AI service. An optional Ollama integration enables conversational assistance through a locally hosted model; this requires separate setup.

💻 The game uses TypeScript, Three.js, HTML, CSS and Canvas, with Vite and Node.js supporting development and builds. Browser storage preserves progress without requiring an account. The core game can be distributed as a static website.

♿ Design considerations include Spanish and English text, keyboard and touch input, visible focus states, reduced-motion options and opportunities to retry. Published scientific references inform selected facts, including lunar gravity and planetary order. Orbital control, cultivation and resource systems are deliberately simplified educational models.

🧪 The prototype passed 35 automated tests covering movement, mission logic, challenges, saved progress and assistance behavior. Testing on physical mobile devices, a full accessibility evaluation and classroom trials remain future validation steps. A girl played for hours today. She even asked her mother to send her the link again so she could keep playing at home.

🌟 Wonder Space aims to encourage scientific curiosity, resource awareness and confidence in problem-solving, including among children who do not initially identify with science.

🧠 Use of Super Intelligence (SI)

🎨We used Magnific, ChatGPT, Canva and Gemini to support the creation and editing of images and videos, combined with our own editing. ChatGPT and Codex also assisted with ideation, gameplay design, programming, debugging, automated tests, documentation and Spanish–English translation.

🤖 Nova’s default in-game assistance uses predefined contextual rules. Optional generative assistance requires a separately configured local model through Ollama.

🔬 Scientific references are credited separately from generated content. The development documentation distinguishes implemented features, optional functionality and simplified educational models.
